text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This pre-race atmosphere is unbeatable~! 
It's crackling like lightning coursing 
through my body!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. But this is just the right 
balance!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You can't win a race on momentum alone. 
We've gotta stay sharp and give it our 
all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, right on! Keep your eyes on today's 
race, ya hear!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this! I'll show 'em all 
what the 'White Lightning' is truly made 
of!
